import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    n = int(data[1])
    ok = True
    while n != 0:
        r = n % w
        if r == 0 or r == 1:
            n //= w
        elif r == w - 1:
            n = n // w + 1
        else:
            ok = False
            break
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
